g.text: Stage A: Fast Synchronous Risk (< 200 ms)
g.textArea:
Gate 0 Hard Rules: Physical velocity > 1000 km/h, device rooting, tampering, failed Play Integrity, mock location.
XGBoost S2 Tabular: 30+ behavioral signals (spike ratio, balance drain, payee history, dormant days).
Performance Benchmark: p50 = 30.1 ms, p95 = 39.7 ms at 10 TPS (budget < 200 ms satisfied).
Initial Action a0: ALLOW, REQUIRE_2FA (STEP_UP), or BLOCK. NanoJev is not invoked here.
g.text: Stage B: Sync-Bounded Typology Check (1500 ms Timeout)
g.textArea:
NanoJev Model: Qwen2.5-0.5B ONNX INT8 next-token logit readout across 7 typologies.
Scam Categories: Prize/Fee, Investment, Romance, Impersonation, Fake Selling, Other, None.
Fitted Calibration: T* = 7.12 (reduces ECE from 0.5824 to 0.0919 on validation split V).
Friction Tiers:
• NONE (prob < 0.35): Settle payment directly under a0 without modal.
• MEDIUM (0.35 <= prob < 0.50): Targeted modal warning (Cancel / Pause / Continue).
• HIGH (prob >= 0.50): Targeted modal warning + mandatory 10-min cool-off pause.

Escalate-Only Invariant: RiskTier(final) >= RiskTier(a0). NanoJev may escalate, never downgrade.
Adversarial Robustness: 0 downgrades across 60 prompt injection vectors (100% preservation).
Timeout & Error Fallback: On timeout or exception, orchestrator defaults to a0 with zero failed transfers.
BSP Circular 1213 (AFASA): Moving away from SMS OTP; STEP_UP mapped to in-app biometrics.
STARS AI Governance: Sustainability (local CPU), Transparency, Accountability, Responsibility, Security.
g.text: p50 latency (p95: 39.7 ms) < 200 ms SLA budget strictly met
Sub-millisecond engine lookup; binds memo + S2 tabular facts
0 downgrades across 60 prompt injection attacks and 1000 property tests
Stage B timeout never fails a transfer; safe fallback directly to a0

Summary: The two-stage design provides rapid tabular fraud scoring (< 40 ms) while isolating heavy NLP evaluation into a bounded secondary step. Targeted warnings address authorized push payment scams where step-up authentication alone is ineffective.
